flags.summary: The party met Baba Lysaga at her window (berez/lysaga:window); later visits greet them as returning.
The scarecrows around the stump were fought and burned (encounter berez_scarecrows). Lysaga complains; the field's Narrator line changes.
The marsh lights in the drowned lane were fought at night (encounter berez_drowned_lights).
The party read the drowned burgomaster's diary (prop berez_burgomaster_diary): Marina died with a thorn-scratch over her heart. Opens the deduction at her bier.
Strahd met the party at Marina's monument by night (berez/marina:strahd); he comes only once.
Guard: the region's one milestone (berez/lysaga:milestone) has been given.
Baba Lysaga invited the party into her hut (window: travellers, the lie, or Marina's name). Opens the hut's door; the scarecrows stay still.
The party claimed her boy sent them and she believed it (Deception 15): she talks about him at supper and admits his carriage brought the gem.
The supper scene at her hearth has played (berez/lysaga:supper).
The party watched her closely (Insight at supper, or Ireena refused the almond stew); she notices being watched.
She boasted that she keeps the mountain wizard's memory in a jar on her shelf (berez/lysaga:wizard). The Mad Mage reacts to it.
The party examined the thorned doll over her hearth (berez/hut:poppet).
The party traded silence about Marina for the gem and her pantry (berez/lysaga:bargain_struck). She lives; the pantry opens.
The party lit Marina's grave-lamp while the witch lived, and she flew to the monument to fight without her hut (berez/marina:lamp).
Baba Lysaga died in her own hut (encounter lysaga_in_hut); the hut dies with her. Her last words follow.
Baba Lysaga died at Marina's monument (encounter lysaga_at_monument); the masterless hut guards its stump.
Baba Lysaga and her hut died together at her door (encounter lysaga_and_hut, the hard way).
The party finished Baba Lysaga in the mud after Strahd broke her hut (encounter lysaga_scorned).
After Strahd broke her hut, the party left Baba Lysaga alive in the mud (berez/lysaga:leave_broken); she threw them the gem.
Baba Lysaga is dead (set by her last words, wherever she fell). Later regions and the epilogue read it.
How the witch of Berez ended: slain, bargained (alive, silence bought) or broken (alive, ruined by Strahd). Castle Ravenloft and the epilogue read it.
Baba Lysaga's creeping hut is dead: with her in the hut or at her door, or fought masterless after the lure.
The party dug out the stair under Marina's statue (berez/marina:dig); the vault exit opens.
The party lit the grave-lamp at Marina's feet.
Medicine at Marina's bier found the thorn-scratch over her heart (berez/marina:bier_medicine).
The party knows Baba Lysaga killed Marina (the doll, her slip in front of Ireena, the deduction at the bier, or her last words). Castle Ravenloft may read it.
The party told Strahd his nurse killed Marina (berez/marina:strahd_truth). He breaks her hut; she is found ruined. Castle Ravenloft and the epilogue read it.
Ireena saw Marina's statue and knew the vault's steps without being told (berez/marina:monument).
The party has the Wizard of Wines' third stone from Berez (the cradle, the bargain, or the broken witch). Also moves quest the_third_stone to found; the Wizard of Wines package reads both.
The party met the Mad Mage on Mount Baratok.
Insight showed the Mad Mage keeps looking at the cairn on the summit.
A wizard named the spell he mutters, and his own name with it; it hurt him.
The party opened the warded cairn and found his spellbook (mount_baratok/events:cairn).
He read his own name in the spellbook; the last page will finish the cure.
The party tried Arcana 16 to talk him back to himself (one try).
The party has the witch's jar holding the wizard's memory (from her shelf, or demanded in the bargain).
Mordenkainen has his memory back (jar, Greater Restoration, spellbook, or Arcana). Only now can he join; the castle (Phase 6) may read it.
Restored and not the Tarokka ally, Mordenkainen promised to come when the party goes up to the castle (Phase 6 should read it).
The party saw the Mad Mage's evening lightning on the ridge (mount_baratok/events:lightning_ridge).
The ward around the summit cairn was spotted (trap baratok_ward).
Mordenkainen told the party the Tsolenka watchword: cold hearth, shut door.
The ghost watch challenged the party in the guard tower.
How the party got past the watch: passed (watchword or a believed lie), released (rites or the truth), fought. The Amber Temple package may read it.
The party tried claiming to be the relief (one try).
Persuasion or Religion to release the watch failed once; those options close.
The watch was laid to rest and is gone from the tower.
The watch was fought and destroyed (encounter tsolenka_watch).
The Tsolenka portcullis is up (tsolenka_pass/watch:winch_up): the road to the Amber Temple opens on the travel map. The Amber Temple package reads it.
The roc of Mount Ghakis flew over the party on a mountain road (tsolenka_pass/events:roc_shadow).
The roc of Mount Ghakis was fought on the bridge (encounter roc_of_ghakis); the bridge is safe by day.
